items.quote: Gaal son of Ebed moved with his clan into Shechem, and its citizens put their confidence in him.
items.contrast: Gaal, in whom the citizens placed confidence, versus Zebul, who is identified only as Abimelek’s deputy.
items.reason: The reader must connect “him” to Gaal and distinguish that trust relationship from Zebul’s role. The window uniquely supports Gaal son of Ebed.
